purpose: Structural checker controls only. Mutations run in memory and never edit src/driver.rs or invoke a prover.

controls.reason: a clone escapes the sole cursor-threaded registration path
a callback hides a registration event and does not complete its cursor transition
a live affine ticket is forgotten before retirement
a handle moves to an untracked thread
a raw pointer aliases the cursor or a live handle
an event call omits the local cursor
a comment-shaped event cannot replace an executable registration
a string-shaped event cannot replace an executable registration
registration is attributed to a different source ticket
an extra issued ticket is not represented in the accepted transcript
the driver shadows the crate's Registry import
a duplicate entrypoint is added to the caller module
the crate root redirects the Registry module through an alias

semantic_boundary: Driver-level event trace only. Generic facade callback bodies, support-module effects, ghost/spec-macro expansion, codegen and native interpretation are not correspondence-derived and remain reviewed TCB. There is no native MIR mapping claim, Registry event-contract proof, final-recovery theorem, actual Bytes coverage, or unwind claim.
